parsed.rationale: Both `WXYCBackground.wxycBackgroundLight` (in `BackgroundGradient.swift`, line 20) and `WXYCGradient.wxycBackgroundLight` (in `WXYCGradient.swift`, line 21) are exact-duplicate computed properties living in the same `WXUI` package with no restraint markers. The duplication suggests that `WXYCBackground` is either a redundant type or a thin wrapper whose `wxycBackgroundLight` property should be consolidated onto `WXYCGradient` (or a shared extension thereof) and the duplicate removed from `BackgroundGradient.swift`. Keeping two identically-named, identically-implemented computed properties on two different types in the same package creates confusion about which is canonical and risks the two implementations diverging silently.
